control_flow: followInTheDark: if LLIGHT is below 70 (dim light in a tunnel): if the line tracker is below 40 (black line) curve left, else if above 88 (white band) curve right, else set no motor; otherwise (bright light) set no motor.
avoidWalls, driveInTheDark, stopAtWall and followLine are defined but never called from the start, so their blocks never run.
